measurement: Frozen conditional industry/role coding of seven 2017 R&D guides; not an annual opportunity index or firm eligibility record.

function_definitions.P: Pollution, emissions or environmentally harmful input reduction
function_definitions.W: Water saving, reuse or nonconventional water production
function_definitions.R: Material/feed/food loss reduction or residue reuse
function_definitions.K: Ecosystem conservation, restoration or soil-maintaining forestry

role_definitions.supplier: Conditional development of named new products, equipment or software
role_definitions.process_rd: Conditional development of named new operating or manufacturing methods
role_definitions.user: Possible use of the technology; not automatically a development role

coding_protocol.review_trigger: Coding was revised after an earlier comparison. The review was not blinded. Branch decisions were based on the technical descriptions and industry definitions, not on outcome values, coefficients or significance.
coding_protocol.role_rule: A named new product/equipment/software gives a conditional supplier role; a named new operating/manufacturing method gives a conditional process-R&D role. Adoption, raw-material supply or demonstration-site presence alone gives neither. Codes describe possible activity domains, not the project's actual applicants or verified firm R&D.
coding_protocol.category_rule: Official basic/applied/demonstration headings are retained but do not veto explicit qualifying technical outputs. Mere mechanisms, generic green labels, yield/quality and existing integration remain insufficient.
coding_protocol.representation: Keep separate supplier, process-R&D and user evidence with nominal technology-family labels and original six functions. No primary supplier/process union, raw task count, weighted family count, budget, prospective patent target or opportunity score.
coding_protocol.zero_and_unknown: A within-linked-role zero only means no qualifying branch in this fixed ledger. An unlinked/unresolved role remains unknown. Uncollected programs, years and actual firm business eligibility are not zero-filled.
coding_protocol.completeness: Source directions and branch anchors were checked for all 139 directions. Only selected role assignments and activity splits received a targeted source review. Other industry links remain provisional. Unresolved decisions on manufacturer subtypes and functions are recorded.
coding_protocol.family_boundary: Families preserve technical subject matter, differ in breadth and can overlap. They are nominal labels, not equal-sized or independently counted opportunities.
